description: React component for displaying a calendar of daily coding challenges, including fetching challenge data, rendering calendar days, and navigation between months.

classes.name: DailyCodingChallengeCalendarProps
classes.description: Props interface for the DailyCodingChallengeCalendar component.

classes.name: AllDailyChallengeFromDb
classes.description: Interface representing challenge data fetched from the database.

classes.name: DailyChallengeMap
classes.description: Structure representing a challenge with its associated data and completed languages.

classes.name: MonthInfo
classes.description: Information about a specific month displayed in the calendar.

methods.name: getMonthInfo
methods.description: Generates calendar data for a specific month, including days and challenge info.

methods.name: fetchChallenges
methods.description: Fetches challenge data from API and initializes calendar state.

methods.name: nextMonth
methods.description: Advances the calendar view to the next month.

methods.name: prevMonth
methods.description: Moves the calendar view to the previous month.

methods.name: hasOlderChallenges
methods.description: Checks if there are challenges in months before the current view.

methods.name: hasNewerChallenges
methods.description: Checks if there are challenges in months after the current view.
